title: Implement Shape ABC with Circle and Rectangle subclasses
description: Greenfield Python task: define an abstract Shape class with abstract area() and perimeter() methods, implement Circle and Rectangle concrete subclasses, and a total_area helper.

import math
import pytest
from src.shapes import Shape, Circle, Rectangle, total_area


def test_circle_area():
    c = Circle(radius=5)
    assert abs(c.area() - math.pi * 25) < 1e-9


def test_circle_perimeter():
    c = Circle(radius=3)
    assert abs(c.perimeter() - 2 * math.pi * 3) < 1e-9


def test_rectangle_area():
    r = Rectangle(width=4, height=6)
    assert r.area() == 24.0


def test_rectangle_perimeter():
    r = Rectangle(width=3, height=5)
    assert r.perimeter() == 16.0


def test_total_area():
    shapes = [Circle(radius=1), Rectangle(width=2, height=3)]
    assert abs(total_area(shapes) - (math.pi + 6.0)) < 1e-9


def test_shape_is_abstract():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        Shape()  # Cannot instantiate abstract class
